'''Reye Sedeya''' was a [[Stassian]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. Without realizing the extent of his skills, Sedeya managed to win large amounts of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] by [[Gambling/Legends|betting]] on [[ringers|ringer]] tournaments. His activities brought him to the attention of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Tren Pergallis]]' [[Special Investigations squad]].
